heard: The Nazca carved giant lines by clearing the trees holding their desert. Intricate geoglyphs of animals stretched across more than 1,300 kilometers of dry plateau. Expanding maize and cotton agriculture required removing deep-rooted warango trees. An El Niño event around 500 AD unleashed torrential coastal flooding. Without root systems, the unprotected soil washed away into deep river channels. Their sophisticated irrigation aqueducts dried up as a civilization collapsed into a barren desert. The Nazca carved giant lines by clearing the trees holding their desert.
